function: Learned control of transmit power of UEs and UAVs, jointly with task offloading, UAV trajectory and computation allocation, to maximize priority-weighted delay and energy gain (p. 8).
system: 3 UAVs, 30 UEs; UAVs with multiple antennae (number not given); G2A, A2A, A2G links of 20, 40, 10 MHz, carrier frequency not given; no RIS (pp. 4, 11).
method: CLP: TD3 actor-critic DRL with hybrid action representation (embedding table plus conditional VAE latent space); reinforcement learning with a warm-up stage on a replay buffer (pp. 8-10).
data_channel: Simulated G2A and A2G probabilistic LoS/NLoS path loss, A2A free-space path loss; 30 UEs random in 1000x1000 m^2; no 3GPP model, public dataset or measurement (pp. 4-5, 10-11).
test_conditions: Single simulated environment for training and evaluation; sweeps over UAV number (1-6), UE number and reward weights; no trained policy reused in an unseen setting (pp. 11-13).
baselines: Learned: OSU (DDPG), NCO (PPO), CMA (multi-agent TD3); non-learned: CNL (greedy approximation); ablations NAR and ORD (pp. 11-13).
metrics: System gain (priority-based delay utility minus energy), task delay, completion rate, energy consumption; reward convergence (pp. 7, 11-14).
complexity: Order O(M^2 N l1 + M N l2 + M N^2 + M l1 l2) from layer sizes (overall algorithm); no runtime or FLOPs (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "a probabilistic path loss model which considers the occurrence probabilities and path loss of LoS and Non-LoS (NLoS) communication" for G2A. Missing: no 3GPP TR 38.811 or 38.901, DeepMIMO or measured data; A2A is free space (p. 5).
q2_support: p. 13: "To show the effect of the number of UEs, we set different numbers of users in the experiment, with a maximum value of 240." Missing: no trained policy tested on an unseen setting; state and action sizes depend on M and N (pp. 7-8).
q3_support: p. 11: "proposed a greedy approximation algorithm as a solution" (CNL, non-learned) and "A multi-agent TD3 algorithm is designed" (CMA, learned); system gain compared in Fig. 6 (p. 12).
q4_support: p. 10: "the overall complexity of our algorithm is" given as an order in M, N, l1 and l2 (Section V-C).
q5_support: p. 10: "We consider a UAVs-assisted MEC scenario with 30 UEs randomly distributed" in a simulator. Missing: no code or data link, DOI or public dataset in the paper.
notes: Borderline inclusion under the above_phy rule: the learned action a(t) includes the transmit power of all UEs and UAVs (p. 8), learned jointly with offloading, UAV trajectory and computation allocation, so the joint-decision clause applies; area 6 for power control on aerial links. Carrier frequency and antenna number are never given. q3 rests on Fig. 6 (CMA, CNL, NCO, OSU). Complexity is analytic only.
